title: Can and Cannot
introduction: Practise can and cannot with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Use can to say what someone is able to do and cannot to say what they are not able to do.
rules: Use the action word without adding s after can.
Ask Can you ...? to find out about an ability.

grammar.description: A fish cannot walk on legs.

examples.question: A fish can ___ (swim or swims).
steps: Use the action word without adding s after can.

examples.question: A cat ___ read a book. (can or cannot)
steps: Ask Can you ...? to find out about an ability.

exercises.question: A cat ___ read a book. (can or cannot)

summary: Use can to say what someone is able to do and cannot to say what they are not able to do.
